title: Brand Pivot: Practice Space, Not Fight Club
subtitle: Boxing reframed as a tool for self-mastery, using hard-science language.
key_concept: The brand shifts from combat to practice, with boxing as a means for stress inoculation and nervous system regulation.
visual_metaphor: A boxing ring in a cathedral nave, ropes replaced by geometric amber lines, with a lone figure meditating in the center.
highlights: Self-mastery is the purpose, boxing is the tool
why_it_matters: Crosses the border from fighting to practice, redefining the core identity and market positioning.
zone_change: Brand identity shifted from Combat zone to Practice zone, with new language and purpose.
